study type: Prognostic study (secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial)
exposure: early neurologic clinical examination (<6 hours of age)
classification and regression tree (CART) models using early clinical variables
outcome: death or moderate or severe disability at 18-22 months
cohort: The study included 364 neonates diagnosed with moderate or severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).
finding: Three prognostic models (scoring system, CART, and early neurologic evaluation) were comparable in predicting death or disability, with CART models proving superior for predicting in-hospital death.
